svg.title: Math Tutor: three-adapter routing
svg.desc: A lesson request is routed by explicit difficulty or a keyword heuristic to one of three LoRA adapters sharing a Qwen3-4B backbone. The draft passes through base-model cleanup, validation and Manim rendering to produce a video and code.
